evidence: Carries Consensus label, modifies src/script/interpreter.cpp and src/script/interpreter.h to implement OP_CAT in Tapscript.
rationale: The PR implements a major proposed consensus opcode (BIP-347 OP_CAT) in the Tapscript interpreter, which warrants deliberate validation review to verify interpreter bounds and execution correctness. While consensus has not yet formed around activation, validating the opcode implementation and its 520-byte stack limits addresses a prominent script capability proposal.
